{"candidate_rtl":"module crc32_d8 (
    input wire [7:0] data_in,
    input wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0] data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    function [39:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [31:0] state_mask [0:31];
        reg [7:0] data_mask [0:31];
        reg [31:0] output_state_mask [0:7];
        reg [7:0] output_data_mask [0:7];
        reg [31:0] state_value;
        reg [7:0] data_value;
        reg [7:0] bit_mask;
        integer i;
        integer j;
        integer pass;
        begin
            for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
                state_mask[i] = 32'b0;
                state_mask[i][i] = 1'b1;
                data_mask[i] = 8'b0;
            end
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                output_state_mask[i] = 32'b0;
                output_data_mask[i] = 8'b0;
                output_state_mask[i][i] = 1'b1;
            end

            for (pass = 0; pass < 8; pass = pass + 1) begin
                bit_mask = 8'h80 >> pass;
                state_value = state_mask[31];
                data_value = data_mask[31] ^ bit_mask;

                for (j = 31; j > 0; j = j - 1) begin
                    state_mask[j] = state_mask[j-1];
                    data_mask[j] = data_mask[j-1];
                end
                for (j = 7; j > 0; j = j - 1) begin
                    output_state_mask[j] = output_state_mask[j-1];
                    output_data_mask[j] = output_data_mask[j-1];
                end
                output_state_mask[0] = state_value;
                output_data_mask[0] = data_value;
                state_mask[0] = state_value;
                data_mask[0] = data_value;

                for (j = 1; j < 32; j = j + 1) begin
                    if ((32'h04c11db7 >> j) & 1'b1) begin
                        state_mask[j] = state_mask[j] ^ state_value;
                        data_mask[j] = data_mask[j] ^ data_value;
                    end
                end
            end

            state_value = 32'b0;
            data_value = 8'b0;
            if (index < 32) begin
                for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1)
                    state_value[i] = state_mask[31-index][31-i];
                for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
                    data_value[i] = data_mask[31-index][7-i];
            end else begin
                for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1)
                    state_value[i] = output_state_mask[7-(index-32)][31-i];
                for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
                    data_value[i] = output_data_mask[7-(index-32)][7-i];
            end
            crc_mask = {data_value, state_value};
        end
    endfunction

    function integer popcount8;
        input [7:0] value;
        integer i;
        begin
            popcount8 = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
                popcount8 = popcount8 + value[i];
        end
    endfunction

    function integer bit_position;
        input [7:0] value;
        input integer bit_index;
        integer i;
        begin
            bit_position = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < bit_index; i = i + 1)
                bit_position = bit_position + value[i];
        end
    endfunction

    genvar n;
    genvar k;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_rows
            localparam [39:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            localparam integer TERMS = popcount8(MASK[7:0]) + popcount8(MASK[15:8]) + popcount8(MASK[23:16]) + popcount8(MASK[31:24]);
            localparam integer DATA_TERMS = popcount8(MASK[39:32]);
            localparam integer N = TERMS + DATA_TERMS;
            wire [N-1:0] operands;
            for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin : state_inputs
                if (MASK[k])
                    assign operands[bit_position(MASK[31:0], k)] = state_in[k];
            end
            for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin : data_inputs
                if (MASK[k+32])
                    assign operands[TERMS + bit_position(MASK[39:32], k)] = data_in[k];
            end
            crc32_d8_xor_tree #(.N(N)) reduce (.a(operands), .y(state_out[n]));
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 8; n = n + 1) begin : data_rows
            localparam [39:0] MASK = crc_mask(n+32);
            localparam integer TERMS = popcount8(MASK[7:0]) + popcount8(MASK[15:8]) + popcount8(MASK[23:16]) + popcount8(MASK[31:24]);
            localparam integer DATA_TERMS = popcount8(MASK[39:32]);
            localparam integer N = TERMS + DATA_TERMS;
            wire [N-1:0] operands;
            for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin : state_inputs
                if (MASK[k])
                    assign operands[bit_position(MASK[31:0], k)] = state_in[k];
            end
            for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin : data_inputs
                if (MASK[k+32])
                    assign operands[TERMS + bit_position(MASK[39:32], k)] = data_in[k];
            end
            crc32_d8_xor_tree #(.N(N)) reduce (.a(operands), .y(data_out[n]));
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module crc32_d8_xor_tree #(
    parameter integer N = 1
) (
    input wire [N-1:0] a,
    output wire y
);
    generate
        if (N == 1) begin : single
            assign y = a[0];
        end else begin : split
            localparam integer LEFT_N = N / 2;
            wire left_value;
            wire right_value;
            crc32_d8_xor_tree #(.N(LEFT_N)) left_tree (
                .a(a[LEFT_N-1:0]),
                .y(left_value)
            );
            crc32_d8_xor_tree #(.N(N-LEFT_N)) right_tree (
                .a(a[N-1:LEFT_N]),
                .y(right_value)
            );
            assign y = left_value ^ right_value;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule","bottleneck":"The original implementation presents wide, irregular XOR reductions for each output bit. The prior candidate also formed an incorrect reduced input grouping and did not preserve the original reflected Galois state/data mapping for arbitrary state_in.","rewrite":"The rewrite computes the exact 40-bit coefficient mask of every output bit by elaboration-time simulation of the original eight Galois shifts, including the reverse operation and feedback data outputs. Each output then uses only the selected state_in and data_in terms, reduced by a recursively balanced XOR tree.","expected_timing_gain":"Balanced logarithmic XOR depth should materially reduce maximum data arrival compared with the original wide reduction network, while retaining direct combinational input-to-output paths and avoiding an eight-stage runtime shift loop.","area_or_other_cost":"The implementation adds elaborated coefficient-generation logic and helper hierarchy, but those are constant-folded before mapping. The mapped datapath consists of sparse XOR trees and is expected to remain within the stated area cap; no storage, buffering assumptions, or extra ports are introduced.","functional_boundaries":"Exact equivalence is intended for all 8-bit data_in and all 32-bit state_in values. The candidate preserves the original CRC32 Galois polynomial 32'h04c11db7, eight MSB-first internal shifts, reflected state and data outputs, default combinational behavior, output widths, and module interface."}
